title: VitePress Site Configuration
description: Schema for the VitePress site configuration object exported from .vitepress/config.[js|ts|mjs|mts]. Defines all settings that control site metadata, routing, theming, Markdown processing, Vite and Vue integration, and build hooks for generating static documentation sites powered by Vite and Vue.

title.description: Title for the site. Displayed in the nav bar when using the default theme and used as the default suffix for all individual page titles.

titleTemplate.description: Suffix or template for page titles. Use ':title' as a placeholder for the page title. Set to false to disable title suffixes.

description.description: Description for the site rendered as a meta tag in each page's HTML.

head.description: Additional elements to render in the <head> tag. Each item is a tuple of [tag, attributes] or [tag, attributes, innerHTML].

lang.description: Language attribute for the site, e.g. 'en-US'. Rendered as the lang attribute of the <html> element.

base.description: The base URL the site will be deployed at. Must start and end with a slash. All internal links will be prepended with this value.

srcDir.description: The directory where your Markdown pages are stored, relative to project root.

srcExclude.description: Glob patterns for Markdown files that should be excluded from being treated as content source files.

outDir.description: The build output location for the site, relative to project root.

assetsDir.description: Specify the directory to nest generated assets under. The path should be inside outDir.

cacheDir.description: The directory for cache files, relative to project root.

ignoreDeadLinks.description: When true, VitePress will not fail builds due to dead links. Can be an array of strings, RegExp patterns, or filter functions for selective ignoring.

oneOf.description: A RegExp pattern or custom filter function (represented as object in JSON Schema).

lastUpdated.description: Whether to get the last updated timestamp for each page using Git. When enabled with the default theme, displays the last updated time on each page.

appearance.description: Whether to enable dark mode. true uses system preference, 'dark' defaults to dark, false disables toggle, 'force-dark' always dark, 'force-auto' always system preference.

metaChunk.description: Experimental. When true, extracts page metadata to a separate JavaScript chunk instead of inlining it in the initial HTML, reducing per-page payload size.

mpa.description: Experimental. When true, builds in MPA (Multi-Page Application) mode which ships 0kb JavaScript by default at the cost of disabling client-side navigation.

markdown.description: Configuration options for the Markdown-it parser and Shiki syntax highlighter. Passed directly to the internal Markdown-it instance.

vite.description: Raw Vite configuration passed to the internal Vite dev server and bundler. Accepts any Vite UserConfig options.

vue.description: Options passed to the internal @vitejs/plugin-vue instance for configuring Vue SFC compilation.

themeConfig.description: Theme configuration object. When using the default theme this is typed as DefaultTheme.Config. Custom themes receive this object as-is.

locales.description: Internationalization configuration. Keys are locale paths (or 'root' for the default locale) and values are locale-specific config objects.

buildEnd.description: Build hook called after SSG build completes but before the CLI process exits. Receives the SiteConfig. (Function — represented as object in JSON Schema.)

postRender.description: Build hook called when SSG rendering is done. Allows handling teleports content during SSG. (Function — represented as object in JSON Schema.)

transformHead.description: Build hook to transform the <head> before generating each page. Returns additional HeadConfig entries to merge with existing ones. (Function — represented as object in JSON Schema.)

transformHtml.description: Build hook to transform the HTML content of each page before saving to disk. (Function — represented as object in JSON Schema.)

transformPageData.description: Hook to transform the PageData of each page. Can mutate pageData directly or return a partial object to merge. (Function — represented as object in JSON Schema.)

HeadConfig.description: An HTML head element represented as a tuple. Either [tag, attributes] or [tag, attributes, innerHTML].

items.description: Attribute key-value pairs for the HTML element.

LocaleConfig.description: Per-locale configuration object allowing overrides of site-level config and theme config for a specific language.

label.description: The label for this locale displayed in the language selector.

lang.description: The lang attribute for this locale, e.g. 'en-US', 'zh-CN'.

title.description: Override for the site title in this locale.

description.description: Override for the site description in this locale.

link.description: The link used in the language selector for this locale.

DefaultThemeConfig.description: Configuration for VitePress default theme. Controls navigation, sidebar, search, social links, footer, and other UI elements.

logo.description: Logo displayed in the nav bar. Can be a path string or an object with light/dark variants.

light.description: Path to the light mode logo.

dark.description: Path to the dark mode logo.

siteTitle.description: Override the site title displayed in the nav bar. Set to false to hide the title.

nav.description: Navigation bar items displayed in the top nav.

sidebar.description: Sidebar navigation configuration. Can be a flat array of sidebar items or a multi-sidebar object keyed by path.

base.description: Base path prefix for all sidebar items in this group.

aside.description: Location of the aside (table of contents) component. true=right, 'left'=left, false=hidden.

outline.description: Which header levels to display in the page outline. Can be a number, tuple range, 'deep' (all), or false to hide.

socialLinks.description: Social media links displayed in the nav bar.

footer.description: Footer configuration shown at the bottom of the page.

editLink.description: Edit link configuration for linking to the source file in a repository.

lastUpdatedText.description: Label text for the last updated timestamp displayed at the bottom of pages.

search.description: Search configuration. Supports built-in local search or Algolia DocSearch.

carbonAds.description: Carbon Ads configuration for displaying ads in the sidebar.

i18nRouting.description: When false, disables automatic locale-based URL routing (e.g., /zh/foo instead of /foo).

notFound.description: Customization for the 404 Not Found page.

quote.description: Quote text displayed on the 404 page.

linkLabel.description: Label for the home link on the 404 page.

linkText.description: Text for the home link button on the 404 page.

NavItem.description: A navigation bar item, either a link or a dropdown menu.

text.description: Display text for the nav item.

items.description: Dropdown items for a nav group.

activeMatch.description: RegExp string for matching the active route.

target.description: HTML target attribute for the link.

rel.description: HTML rel attribute for the link.

noIcon.description: When true, suppresses the external link icon.

SidebarItem.description: A sidebar navigation item, which can be a link, a section header, or a collapsible group.

text.description: Display text for the sidebar item.

items.description: Child sidebar items for a group.

collapsed.description: Whether the group is collapsible. If omitted the group is not collapsible. true=collapsible and initially collapsed, false=collapsible but initially expanded.

base.description: Base path prefix for all child items.

docFooterText.description: Custom text for the prev/next footer when this item is active.

rel.description: HTML rel attribute for the link.

target.description: HTML target attribute for the link.

SocialLink.description: A social media link displayed as an icon in the nav bar.

icon.description: Icon identifier or SVG string. Supported values include 'github', 'twitter', 'discord', 'facebook', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'mastodon', 'npm', 'slack', 'youtube', 'x' or an object with an svg property.

svg.description: Raw SVG string for a custom icon.

ariaLabel.description: Accessibility label for the social link icon.

Footer.description: Footer configuration displayed at the bottom of pages in the default theme.

EditLink.description: Configuration for the 'Edit this page' link pointing to the page source in a repository.

pattern.description: URL pattern for the edit link. Use ':path' as a placeholder for the page file path, e.g. 'https://github.com/org/repo/edit/main/docs/:path'.

text.description: Display text for the edit link.

options.description: Provider-specific options. For 'algolia', includes appId, apiKey, and indexName. For 'local', includes locales and other local search settings.

CarbonAdsConfig.description: Carbon Ads configuration for displaying ads in the documentation sidebar.
